saw_lines: Performance buyers rarely shop a whole wardrobe. They pick one piece for the workout or commute and replace it when it wears.
So the sale is won in the first line, where buyers decide if the price and offer are worth a click.
Your site offers 15% off, yet 0 of 23 ads mention it. Put the 15% off in the opening line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 15% off, yet 0 of 23 ads mention it, so new buyers see no reason to act today. Put the 15% off in the opening line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

Your homepage lists $125, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so a buyer cannot judge value before the click. Lead one ad with the $125 price and what it replaces, then test it against the Landmark 1/4 Zip.
0 of 23 ads carry a proof number, so buyers have no sign that other people chose it. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead three new ads with it.
3 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a buyer who taps the piece they saw lands somewhere else and has to search again. Point each of those three ads to the exact product on screen.

ads_1: Offer first creative with 15% off up front, tested against the price angle
